name: wave-text
title: Wave Text
description: Each glyph rides a sine wave with a phase offset from its position, producing a travelling swell through the word; implemented with per-character spans and a shared animation-delay variable.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Geometric
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Ambient Loop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
